title: What Coding Agents Leave Unsaid: Measuring Task-State Gaps Between Execution and Reports
abstract: arXiv:2610.20003v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Human supervisors rely on coding agents' reports to assess progress, verify repairs, and decide when to intervene. But a supervisor cannot investigate a failure they were never told occurred. Failed attempts, workarounds, and unresolved risks may disappear from routine reports, leaving supervisors unaware of issues that warrant scrutiny. We conduct CTXGAP, a measurement study quantifying the gap in task-state recoverability between agents' accumulated user-facing reports and their full recorded execution contexts. Across 37 coding tasks and 4,799 valid probes, agents answer 93.6% of task-state questions on demand; full-context readers recover 92.7%, while report-only readers recover 52.0%, a 40.7-point gap. At the final checkpoints of 30 verified fixes, the gap remains 34.8 points. translated_title: 编程智能体的未言之事：测量执行与报告之间的任务状态差距
translated_abstract: 人类监督者依赖编程智能体的报告来评估进度、验证修复效果并决定何时进行干预。但监督者无法调查一个他们从未被告知发生过的失败。失败的尝试、临时变通方案和未解决的风险可能会从例行报告中消失，使监督者对值得审查的问题一无所知。我们开展了CTXGAP，一项量化测量研究，用于衡量智能体累积的面向用户的报告与其完整记录的执行上下文之间在任务状态可恢复性上的差距。在37个编程任务和4,799个有效探测中，智能体能够按需回答93.6%的任务状态问题；具备完整上下文的读者可恢复92.7%的信息，而仅依赖报告的读者只能恢复52.0%，两者相差40.7个百分点。在30个已验证修复的最终检查点上，差距仍达34.8个百分点。人工标注识别出“虽被提及但缺乏足够支持细节的状态”是未恢复信息的最大类别，而模型评估的超级……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CTXGAP测量研究，首次量化揭示了编程智能体面向用户的报告存在严重信息缺失——仅依赖报告的读者只能恢复52.0%的任务状态信息，而拥有完整执行上下文的读者可恢复92.7%，差距高达40.7个百分点，表明智能体报告中遗漏了失败尝试、变通方案和未解决风险等关键信息。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CTXGAP, a measurement study that quantifies a substantial gap in task-state recoverability between coding agents' user-facing reports and their full execution contexts, finding that report-only readers recover just 52.0% of task states versus 92.7% for full-context readers—a 40.7-point gap—revealing that failed attempts, workarounds, and unresolved risks often go unreported.
